contract.conditioning_assumption: Hypothetically the 1e-6 per-attempt scalar bounds the entire coherent pre-readout unitary error, including angle/loading/compilation errors. QDK does not certify this assumption.
contract.mean_fit_limitation: A mean-fit rotation scalar is not an operator-norm bound or synthesis runtime-tail guarantee; conditional compiled-output fields are proposals.
contract.output: one Z(q0) mean of the normalized A^-1 b solution at each fixed instance
contract.scope: each case is a separate requested task, not a simultaneous guarantee over the sweep

error_composition: UnionBound; approximation base and physical contribution explicitly separated
excluded: fresh clean logical-zero initialization/reset timing and faults
classical coefficient/lookup construction, compilation, reference solving and readout communication/processing
general matrix or arbitrary vector loading
concrete Clifford+T synthesis sequence, coherent-error certificate and synthesis runtime-tail guarantee
included: all operations in supplied bound circuit
explicit input preparation and output basis changes if supplied
limitations: The synthesis formula is a mean linear fit for random angles, not a worst-case bound or certified concrete Clifford+T implementation
The fit models expected fallback-protocol work; no synthesis runtime-tail or budget-overrun confidence is certified
The QDK trace abstracts Clifford work and scheduling into PSSPC rather than preserving an exact gate schedule
Physical reliability is conditional on the declared hardware/QEC/factory models
No algorithm approximation, optimizer convergence, or observable precision is inferred from the circuit
Classical optimizer/preprocessing/compilation/verification costs and external data loading are excluded
A bounded-observable contract covers one fixed scalar mean only when its declared assumptions hold
pareto_completeness: enumerated ISA combinations; limited to declared models/domains

postselection_contract.output: one Z(q0) mean of the normalized A^-1 b solution at each fixed instance

assumptions: IID fresh preparations of the declared b state
the uniform exact-rational/promise acceptance lower bound holds for the ideal circuit
Hypothetically the 1e-6 per-attempt scalar bounds the entire coherent pre-readout unitary error, including angle/loading/compilation errors. QDK does not certify this assumption.
one fixed normalized-solution Pauli mean; rejected attempts pay the full schedule
workload.probability_scope: one lower bound used for every retry; never substituted by a small-case numerical acceptance
workload.status: unexecuted capped compiled-output proposal, conditional on the coherent-eta and hardware assumptions

provenance.source_commit_scope: exact checkout at generation if available; per-file content hashes identify working implementation

synthesis.cost_semantics: mean linear fit for random angles; not worst-case or certified per angle
